name: Band Ankle Inversion

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: Cornell Health Physical Therapy Ankle Protocol

steps: Sit with legs extended, crossing your non-target leg over the target leg.
Loop a resistance band around the inside of your target foot and anchor the other end to the outside of your resting foot.
Start with the target foot turned slightly outward under light tension.
Turn your target foot inward toward the center line of your body against the band's resistance.
Hold for one second at the end range, then slowly return to the starting position.
coaching_cues: Isolate the movement to the ankle joint; do not rotate your entire leg or hip inward.
Feel the contraction along the inside of your lower calf and arch.

sources.attribution: Cornell Health Physical Therapy Exercise Protocol
